dad.definition: n. an informal term for a father; probably derived from baby talk

dada.definition: n. a nihilistic art movement (especially in painting) that flourished in Europe early in the 20th century; based on irrationality and negation of the accepted laws of beauty
dada.translation: n. 爸爸, 达达主义派的文艺作品

dadaism.definition: n a nihilistic art movement (especially in painting) that flourished in Europe early in the 20th century; based on irrationality and negation of the accepted laws of beauty
dadaism.translation: n. 达达派, 达达主义（崇尚虚无的艺术派别）

dadaist.translation: n. 达达主义的艺术家

dadaists.translation: (Dadaist 的复数) n. 达达主义的艺术家

dade.definition:
v. t. To hold up by leading strings or by the hand, as a child

   learning to walk; to move slowly.
